Strings.component_center.inspection_capacity: The server has reached its saved-plan limit. Ask the server administrator to review retained records.
Strings.component_center.inspection_storage_fail: The server could not save the inspection result. Ask the server administrator to check plan storage.
Strings.component_center.inspection_no_catalog: Installation state checked. No source catalog is loaded, so the catalog was not checked. Select a source and refresh to check it.
Strings.component_center.inspect_hint: Read the component installation state and selected source catalog to identify issues.
Strings.component_center.inspection_changed: State has changed. Refresh the component and check again.
Strings.component_center.inspection_complete: Check complete. Results reflect the state at the time of inspection.
Strings.component_center.inspection_denied: Permission to read component state was denied.
Strings.component_center.inspection_failed: The check failed. Refresh and try again.
Strings.component_center.persistence_hint: Drafts are saved on this device. Preview replans and requests approval after restart.
Strings.component_center.persistence_failed: Draft storage could not be read or saved. Current selections remain in this process only; check local storage and retry.
Manage host components, trusted versions and recovery.
Strings.component_center.required_message: The required component is missing on this host. Confirm to open Component Center. Opening it does not install anything.
Strings.component_center.staged: Added to pending changes; nothing has been installed or authorized.
Strings.component_center.draft_hint: Selections only edit a local draft. Preview replans on the host.
Strings.component_center.close_message: Keep to reopen on this server. Discard only clears the draft; it does not uninstall components.
Strings.component_center.draft_conflict: This component has a different pending change. Remove it before choosing another.
Strings.component_center.draft_stale: The host, installation identity or target changed. Select the change again.
Strings.component_center.host_mismatch: The target host differs from the current connection. Connect to it in Server Center first.
Strings.component_center.located: Located sing-box. No change was selected or installation started.
Strings.component_center.source_select: The installed source could not be uniquely matched. Explicitly select a source and review its identity.
Strings.component_center.source_ambiguous: The active release appears in multiple sources. Explicitly select a source.
Strings.component_center.availability.Unknown: The component state could not be confirmed. Check the connection and retry. An unknown state never triggers installation.
Strings.component_center.availability.Missing: Proxy Server requires sing-box. The required component is not installed on this host.
Strings.component_center.availability.Stopped: The component is installed and the service is stopped.
Strings.component_center.availability.Faulted: The component is installed but reports a fault.
Strings.component_center.availability.External: An external installation was detected. View ownership in Component Center; it will not be taken over automatically.
Strings.component_center.availability.Recovery: The component has a transaction requiring recovery. Open Component Center to recover it.
Strings.component_center.availability.Busy: A component task is already running. View progress in Component Center.
Strings.component_center.availability.Unsupporte: This host does not support the component.
Strings.component_center.availability.NoPermissi: You do not have permission to read this application’s dependency state. Ask an administrator.
Strings.component_center.ready_only_hint: Filter desktop and application lists. Component Center, Settings and recovery remain available. Shortcuts still check dependencies on the current host.
Strings.component_center.observation_unknown: Installation state has not been observed. Refresh the current host.
Strings.component_center.evidence_commit: Original operation commit: state revision {0}, measured version {1}, active release {2}.
Strings.component_center.evidence_commit_missing: No successful commit evidence was saved for the original operation; a success receipt alone cannot prove recovery is complete.
Strings.component_center.updates_unknown: Updates cannot be determined yet. Select a source and refresh its catalog in Release sources; a failed query or expired catalog cannot establish that this is the latest version.
Strings.component_center.updates_requires_manage: Only managed installations support update checks. Check installation state and ownership in All components.
Strings.component_center.no_updates: No confirmed newer stable release is available in this catalog. Check catalog freshness in Release sources.
Strings.component_center.explicit_action: The component is installed. Use an explicit update, repair, rollback or removal action.
Strings.component_center.select_version: Read host state and select a trusted source and an exact version first.
Strings.component_center.selection_hint: Checkboxes edit pending changes. Installation state and version are shown separately.
Strings.component_center.workload_hint: A workload references components; it is not a separate package. Selecting requirements only stages local intent.
Strings.component_center.component_unknown: This component is absent from the catalog and cannot be planned.
Strings.component_center.change_plan_ready: The server has frozen this proposal. It has not been approved or executed.
Strings.component_center.task_confirm_hint: Review every action, target version, data impact and digest below. Execution uses this exact plan.
Strings.component_center.task_service_impact: The service may be stopped or restarted.
Strings.component_center.task_credentials: Verify a host administrator for this plan only.
Strings.component_center.task_unchecked: No task result has been checked.
Strings.component_center.task_accepted: Task accepted. Progress and final outcome come from the server.
Strings.component_center.task_not_started: Approval has no accepted run yet. Continue explicitly to start it.
Strings.component_center.task_approval_unavailab: Approval is expired or revoked. Create a fresh plan.
Strings.component_center.task_reference_failed: Task references could not be saved or read. No new start is submitted without durable storage.
Strings.component_center.task_request_failed: The task request failed or the session changed. Read status before retrying.
Strings.component_center.task_state.Cancelling: Cancellation requested; waiting for the actual outcome
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_unresolve: The original receipt and current host state do not yet prove the result. Resolve host recovery and check again. No steps were executed again.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_checked: The original receipt and current host state confirm the result. No steps were executed again.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_read_hint: Read the original operation's host recovery state before choosing an action.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_summary: Recovery operation: {0}; recorded requests: {1}. An action response does not prove recovery. Recheck the result.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_effect.Re: Retry only the original transaction's compensation to restore the previous program, configuration and service. This does not install again or resume remaining steps.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_effect.Em: Stop the service associated with this pending transaction. Business connections will be interrupted. The transaction's uncertain result remains unresolved.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_effect.Cl: Close the original transaction after compensation failed and the service stopped. Resources may still need manual attention. This does not mean recovery succeeded.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_response: The recovery action response was recorded. Recheck the task using the host receipt.
Strings.component_center.task_recovery_response_: The original recovery request is recorded, but its response is unknown. The host was not called again. Read the details and recheck the result.
Strings.component_center.recovery_service_unknow: Service state is unknown. Refresh recovery details.
Strings.component_center.recovery_attempt_unknow: Response unknown. Check the host result.
Strings.component_center.recovery_attempt_record: The host responded. Recheck the task result.
Strings.component_center.recovery_attempt_failed: The recovery action did not complete. Read the details again.
Strings.component_center.result_planned_delete: Frozen plan: delete business data. Failure, cancellation or recovery does not prove deletion.
Strings.component_center.result_planned_preserve: Frozen plan: preserve business data. This view does not provide per-resource retention evidence.
Strings.component_center.result_problem: This step could not be confirmed complete. Read the original operation and recovery details. Raw server diagnostics are not displayed here.
Strings.component_center.result_summary: Succeeded {0} · No change {1} · Failed {2} · Skipped {3} · Cancelled {4} · Compensated {5} · Recovery {6}
Strings.component_center.result_evidence_hint: Step states come from the host task record. Planned effects do not replace resource observations. Recovery results still require reconciliation.
Strings.component_center.evidence_missing: No attributable host observation was available at that time.
Strings.component_center.evidence_empty: No host reconciliation evidence has been saved for this task.
Strings.component_center.evidence_history_hint: These are historical task records. Reading does not refresh the host or execute recovery. Resource retention still requires domain evidence.
Strings.component_center.evidence_receipt.Unknow: No matching host receipt was available at that time.
Strings.component_center.integration_runtime_onl: This component's version is managed on the runtime page below and does not enter a batch draft yet.
Strings.component_center.integration_application: Installation still happens inside the owning application; this center only lists the catalog and planned sources.
Strings.component_center.not_integrated_title: This component is not connected to the component center yet
Strings.component_center.not_integrated_message: Installing, updating and removing {0} still happens on that application's own page.
Strings.component_center.not_integrated_scope: The center shows only the catalog entry, install sources and owning application, and offers no install button. These actions move here once the adapter lands.
Strings.component_center.change_plan_hint: Previewing rereads host state and freezes the exact version; approval and execution are separate steps.
Strings.component_center.component.sing-box.desc: Runtime core of Proxy Server: inbounds, principals and configuration publishing.
Strings.component_center.component.mihomo.descri: Runtime core of Proxy Manager: subscription profiles, traffic entry points and network recovery.
Strings.component_center.component.frp.descripti: Client and server programs behind the tunnel application.
Strings.component_center.component.nginx.descrip: Reverse proxy used by the Web Server Manager.
Strings.component_center.component.squid.descrip: HTTP/CONNECT proxy service used by the Squid gateway.
Strings.component_center.component.docker.descri: Container engine required by the Docker Manager.
Strings.component_center.component.samba.descrip: SMB file sharing service used by File Services.
Strings.component_center.observation.title: Host facts
Strings.component_center.observation.hint: Read-only facts the owning application already reports. This panel never installs, plans or approves anything.
Strings.component_center.observation.complete: Read; the facts come from the owning application's API.
Strings.component_center.observation.failed: The host state could not be read. Check the connection and retry.
Strings.component_center.observation.managed_not: The Web Server Manager owns this component as an instance; the install source depends on the platform.
Strings.component_center.observation.candidate_n: A host Nginx was found but is not integrated with the Web Server Manager yet.
Strings.component_center.observation.none: No Nginx managed by RelaxKonOS, and none available to integrate, was found.
Strings.component_center.package.title: Install source freeze
Strings.component_center.package.hint: Resolves the candidate through the install mode this host actually uses: a distribution package comes from the host package manager with its exact version, repository and digest; a managed archive comes from the managed runtime catalog. Resolution only reads facts and installs nothing.
Strings.component_center.package.unresolved: Not resolved yet, or this host has no install mode
Strings.component_center.package.denied: This account may not install the component
Strings.component_center.package.unsupported: This host does not register the component
Strings.component_center.package.problem.executi: this build has no install transaction for that source yet
Strings.component_center.package.problem.unresol: the host package manager resolved no candidate
Strings.component_center.package.problem.index_u: the package index could not be read
Strings.component_center.package.problem.version: the named version is not the host's resolution
Strings.component_center.package.problem.already: already installed as a managed component
Strings.component_center.package.problem.platfor: this platform does not support that install mode
Strings.component_center.package.problem.source_: the requested install mode does not match this platform
